Mind field, fixture `checking` (probes null, checking true): the Engine badge reads 'checking' on status-dot--pending

cards.body:
## Summary
The same fact - Athena could not check the engine - is drawn three ways on two screens: the engine cards say 'not checked' on a warning, the engine section's own summary row and the Mind field's Engine badge say it on a pending dot (the Mind badge's word is 'checking'), and the surface's Mind light calls it 'the engine check failed' and flags it as needing the person. Each rendering keeps its own Standing->word/tone table. Put one display authority in scenes/shared/standing.ts and make all three read it.

## Description
readiness.ts owns the facts (Standing), which is right; what has no owner is the crossing from Standing to word, hue and attention, and the one distinction a Standing cannot carry: unknown-because-in-flight vs unknown-because-the-check-failed. EngineSection solved it locally in unprobed(); the Mind field never got it (view.tsx:62/70), the section's own fact row missed it (EngineSection.tsx:122), and the surface invented a third encoding (model.ts:99,163). standing.ts exports displayOf(standing, {checkFailed}) -> {word, tone, attention} and checkFailedOf(model) (probes null, not checking, problem set or startFailure handled by engineFact). The Mind field's lineOf, the EngineSection fact dot and the surface's mind light derive from it; the surface keeps its short stat phrasing but its attention comes from the same function. This is the status-vocabulary subject's one-authority-per-vocabulary law (technique vocabulary-chain-integrity, status-color-mapping) applied to the display layer that the readiness module deliberately leaves to its callers.

## Flow
- daemon offline -> probes null, problem set, checking false
- before: Mind field badge 'checking' (pending); engine section cards 'not checked' (warning) while its fact row is pending; surface light 'the engine check failed' (attention)
- after: every rendering says the check did not go through on a warning, and the surface's attention flag and the Mind badge are the same function

## Expected impact
A person who sees 'needs you' on the surface and dives finds the same verdict on the Mind field instead of a 'checking' that will never end. The next standing rendering (Waking reuses EngineSection) inherits the rule rather than re-deriving it. Could break: copy on the Mind badge in the failed-check case only; surface stats are pinned unchanged.

## Evaluation
Claim: one Standing display table; the three renderings agree on every setup fixture
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases' new behaviour passes (cases 1, 4, 5, 6, 8 fail today; 2, 3, 7 are guards)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - the acceptance cases (vitest, renderToStaticMarkup, offline)
Result: better
Gate: none

cards.body:
## Summary
The surface reports that something needs the person (a dot and 'needs you' in a light's name) but cannot say what, and its press drops them at the depth's field to hunt for it. Give the surface a 'needs you' list built from facts live.tsx already holds - an account to reconnect, an engine that cannot run, a restart that is pending - each a button that lands on the exact item, and let a light under attention dive to its first need.

## Description
SurfaceModel gains needs: Need[] ({key, label, word, line, to: Path}) and Light gains to: Path. SurfaceActions.dive widens from Root to Path (live: useDepth.go(to)). Sources: accounts carry the connector standing's word and sentence (already computed by standingOf at live.tsx:123), and a pendingRestart read from the setup model live.tsx already builds. Order: engine, restart, accounts; at most three shown, '+N more' dives to the rest's depth. The summon button for waiting cards stays where it is: those are answered in her window (decision D1, ADR 0087), and the list never answers anything itself - every entry is a dive, so the mirror stays a mirror.

## Flow
- before: surface shows Accounts '1 of 3 connected, needs you' -> press -> Accounts field -> scan rows for the warning -> press Gmail -> its level (2 presses + a search; which account and why are unknown until the second screen)
- after: surface shows 'Gmail - needs reconnecting: Gmail let the grant go; connect again to continue.' -> press -> Gmail's level (1 press, the reason read before choosing)
- same for an engine not signed in (lands on Mind > Engine with its remedy) and a pending restart, which the surface does not mention at all today

## Expected impact
The first screen becomes a to-do the person can act on rather than a dashboard of hints; the decision of where to go is made with the reason in view. Could break: the light's aria-label and press target for lights under attention (pinned by cases 4-5); first paint adds one small list (perf:all run).

## Evaluation
Claim: every attention fact the surface holds is named and one press from its item
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases' new behaviour passes (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 fail; 7 is a guard)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - the acceptance cases (vitest; jsdom for interact and live, store state set in-process, offline)
Result: better
Gate: none
